instruction: Repair only two grout defects in this exact paving crop. At the upper half a vertical seam meets an ascending northeast diagonal: remove only the tiny extra southwest spur projecting past that junction; preserve the vertical seam and its clean meeting with the long diagonal. In the lower half, a short diagonal branch extends southwest from a four-way intersection and stops freely inside a slab. Remove that entire dead-end branch from the existing junction to its endpoint, leaving a clean three-way junction and smooth unbroken stone where the branch was. Do not extend that branch. Preserve all other long joints, all outer border pixels, surface lighting/color/texture and crop. Do not create new pavement divisions or marks.
